Accessibility Features

🔊

Auto Text-to-Speech

Decoded text is read aloud automatically using gTTS with offline pyttsx3 fallback.

📷

Webcam Support

Live webcam capture directly in browser. No app installation required for end users.

💡

Camera Guidance

Built-in tips for optimal lighting and angle. Raking light technique explained in UI.

♿

High Contrast UI

Large text output, high-contrast green dot overlays, and accessible colour palette.

💊

Medical Use Case

Designed for caregivers reading Braille medication notes and prescription labels.

📊

Confidence Score

High / medium / low confidence so users know when to retake the photo.

Technology Stack

Python 3.9+ OpenCV 4.x NumPy Gradio gTTS pyttsx3 Pillow Grade 1 Braille (64 patterns) CLAHE Enhancement Adaptive Threshold Contour Detection Gap-based Segmentation
